tables_1.title: Health Audit Check Undertaken by WRSTG(MBI)

cells.value: Operate mounting in manual and power modes as per operating instructions and check for proper functioning of all associated units/subunits
Check firing circuit and opening of firing circuit in the danger zone in BD mode
Check working of follow up system
Check insulation resistance which should not be less than 1 M ohm. Clean the contacts with spirit
Carry out recoil and check the working mechanism of elevating parts during recoil and runout
Check alignment if the reading of TTA and TEA dials of the condenser with the reading of receiving unit
Check the working of firing circuits and opening of firing circuit in danger zone as per firing angle diagram manually and from control panel

tables_1.title: Health Audit Checks Undertaken by NAI(MBI)

cells.value: Check barrel bore for cleaning and condition
Check barrel bore with plug bore gauge
Inspect condition of barrel bore and chamber using video boroscope
Check greasing and operation of breech block
Check oil level of hydraulic buffer
Elevation motor, Training motor, Loading tray buffer
Check cooling system of the barrel (pressure at 170 - 200 ltr/min)
Check pilot lamp cool on control panel
Check for leakage of cooling water through pipe joints inside and outside mounting. Check leakage at breech ring with gun in recoil condition
Check the minimum recoil length for operation of breech block with hydraulic system
Check overall functioning of feed block, rammer carriage mechanism, firing mechanism with dummy at various elevation. Check for FC indication on control panel at 7th round
Carryout misfire drill using 02 in number dummy rounds (Authority: HQWNC/CGO Letter no. GN/0318 dated 02 Sep 20)
